changelog: - fixed the spawner limit issue by changing the time to spawn count.
- added culling logics for gun models in mobs hands to improve performance in case you config the mod to create an army.
- added even more information to the HUD, also with new toggles to customize it.
- fixed the projector item, not being crafted or seen in recipe book.
- enhanced the blacklist screen, to be more helpful so you can configure faster, ban mobs have certain abilities.
- server config sync now requires the player to be owner level 4.
- changed the mod description in mods.toml and updated the project files.
- changed the mod name to Relentless World.
